Problem.Title: Small businesses deserve better.
Problem.Subtitle: The market offers them tools designed for large teams. Not for them.

Problem.Items.Title: Too expensive
Problem.Items.Description: Subscriptions designed for 50-person teams, billed to a single person.

Problem.Items.Title: Too complex
Problem.Items.Description: Interfaces with 200 options to do one thing. The learning curve takes weeks.

Problem.Items.Title: Too intimidating
Problem.Items.Description: Dashboards designed for product managers, not for craftspeople or bar owners.

Problem.Items.Title: Too much bloat
Problem.Items.Description: 90% of features will never be used. But they're there, slowing everything down.

Vision.Title: Why BackLab exists
Vision.Manifesto:
We believe the best tools do less, not more.

We build the 10% of features that generate 90% of the value. Tools that launch in minutes, not weeks. Interfaces you understand without training. Prices accessible to those running their business alone.

BackLab is the anti-bloat solution.
Products.Title: Our products
Products.Subtitle: A coherent range of simple tools, designed for small businesses.

Products.Items.Name: BackBoost
Products.Items.Tagline: Recover forgotten quotes and keep control of your follow-ups.
Products.Items.Description: Stop losing revenue on quotes that sit untouched. BackBoost automates your follow-ups and gives you a clear view of your pipeline.

Products.Items.Name: BackCall
Products.Items.Tagline: Never let a missed call become a lost customer again.
Products.Items.Description: Every unanswered call is an opportunity that goes to your competitor. BackCall reminds you who called and helps you reach back before it's too late.

Products.Items.Name: BackReview
Products.Items.Tagline: Turn satisfied customers into reviews that matter.
Products.Items.Description: Online reviews build your reputation. BackReview simplifies review collection and boosts your visibility effortlessly.

Products.Items.Name: BackFill
Products.Items.Tagline: Fill your empty slots before they cost you money.
Products.Items.Description: An empty slot is lost revenue. BackFill helps you optimize your schedule and fill your availability intelligently.

Products.Items.Name: BackBar
Products.Items.Tagline: Manage your margins and restocking without an infernal ERP.
Products.Items.Description: Built for bars and restaurants, BackBar gives you a simple, clear view of your inventory, margins and restock — without the complexity of an ERP.

Founder.Title: Behind BackLab
Founder.Name: Mathilde Fauveau
Founder.Paragraphs: BackLab wasn't born in a big office. It was born from a concrete frustration: watching small businesses struggle with tools designed for large teams, or giving up on digital entirely because it's too expensive, too complex, too intimidating.
A web developer by training, with experience in digital product and real-world immersion in the world of small businesses, I wanted to create the tools I wished existed.
My approach is simple: pragmatic, useful, immediately. Nothing superfluous. Everything that truly helps.
FAQ.Title: Frequently asked questions

FAQ.Items.Question: Are your tools designed for micro-businesses?
FAQ.Items.Answer: Yes, that's exactly what they were built for. Every BackLab product is designed for 1-10 person businesses who don't have the time or desire to deal with complex software.

FAQ.Items.Question: Do I need technical skills to use your products?
FAQ.Items.Answer: Absolutely not. If you can use WhatsApp, you can use BackLab. Our interfaces are designed to be understood in under 5 minutes, with no training required.

FAQ.Items.Question: Are the products already available?
FAQ.Items.Answer: They are currently in development. Sign up for the waiting list to be among the first to access them and benefit from launch pricing.

FAQ.Items.Question: Do you do custom development?
FAQ.Items.Answer: Yes, in certain cases. If your need is simple, concrete, and none of our products cover your specific situation, we can discuss a tailored solution.

FAQ.Items.Question: Can I contact you for a specific need?
FAQ.Items.Answer: Of course. Send us a message via the contact form or directly by email. We respond within 48 hours.

Contact.Title: We build the tools we wished existed.
Contact.Content: A question about our products? A specific project? Want to join the waiting list? Write to us — we're human and we respond.
